📱 Mobile — Hold the Ride Bike prompt and tap Engine. Use the Steer/Lean stick, Gas, brakes, +/− gears, and numbered trick buttons. Tap Get Off to dismount.

1087859240.creator: Rogue Lineage
1087859240.description:
>> This game is incredibly difficult with little to no hand holding. Enter at your own risk. << 

Nominee for "Sleeper Hit" in the 7th Annual Bloxy Awards. 

Rogue Lineage is a fantasy game with roguelike elements. The game revolves around a permadeath mechanic, where each of your characters will have but a few lives before they die forever. You'll pass down some pieces of yourself to your heir, who'll become your next character. Players will progress by learning new abilities and trying to best their previous characters. Forge houses with your friends to take control of cities, or stick it out alone. Tackle injuries, diseases, and trauma as you struggle to survive in this testament to pain. 

Developed by: Ragoozer, Arch_Mage, Grimmkind, Melon_Sensei, aptorian, Rookie_Ethnic, Sherosama Contributions from: Nilvaat (Weapon Modelling), Blotnik (Clothing), x_o (Music), superstephon (Weapon Modelling) 

Huge Inspiration from Noloafing 
A game by Monad Studios.
1087859240.name: [🎃] Rogue Lineage

1091907805.creator: Unsquared
1091907805.description:
🎁 Welcome to Unboxing Simulator 🎁
Smash boxes, uncover legendary loot, and flex your finds with friends!

[How To Play]
• Open boxes to get hats
• Equip your best hats and weapon to boost damage
• Unlock new worlds, hatch pets, and find even stronger hats
• Visit the Trade Plaza to swap epic items with other players
• Equip perks for powerful effects - some spawn extra boxes, others upgrade or even smash them for you

[Tips]
• Bigger gifts = rarer loot - team up for locked crates!
• Reach Area 3 to hatch pets - pets help you find stronger hats from boxes
• A Locked Crate spawns every 15 min - team up to crack it open for random OP loot like perks or potions

Happy smashing and good luck on the loot!
1091907805.name: Unboxing Simulator [UPDATE]

1093311378.creator: cyberpiper
1093311378.description:
Retrace the footsteps of our ancestors in an 1867 reconstruction of Victorian Luxembourg.

Race through the streets on a ‘Boneshaker’ velocipede, fly through the air on a steampunk flying machine or paddle down the river and view the city from the safety of your very own rowing boat.

There are more than 100 badges to be won from around this beautiful Victorian city.  Can you clear the rats from the courtyard and pick up pure from the streets, to earn some money for food?

Beware of rogues, ghosts, deadly traps and other dangers!

This game is based on an authentic reconstruction of 1867 Luxembourg. Historical documents and photographs have been used throughout, to create an authentic impression of what the city would have looked like during the mid-nineteenth century.

https://devforum.roblox.com/t/1476795

3047037061.creator: bLockerman666
3047037061.description:
Game made by bLockerman666 and aamo_s.

Halloween event is out!
Every 5 rounds won, you can vote to play an event round with others.
Beating the event rounds will reward you with event flags (most of the time).
This event is harder than usual, and it's recommended to play with multiple people.

You can customize the board in private servers! (Note that wins don't count in them)
If you don't want to beat the tutorial, you can either skip it temporarily or play in a private server.
Exploiting of any sorts is NOT allowed in this game, and you will be punished for it.

How to play:
The board is divided into tiles, with mines randomly distributed.
To win, you need to step on all the safe tiles, without stepping on a mine.
The number on a tile shows the number of mines around it in a 3x3 area.
Using this information, you can determine tiles that are safe, and tiles that contain mines.
Tiles suspected of being mines can be marked with a flag using the left mouse button.
3047037061.name: 🎃 bLockerman's Minesweeper 🎃

!! This game is a heavy WIP and just a passion project, so expect bugs and non-final content. !!
"You are going nowhere but to hell... I hope you like it there."

Examination is a PvE horror shooter, where you're tasked to clear a highly irradiated nuclear power plant that's turned into a laboratory in the wake of the WE-30 outbreak, a nation-spanning infection that, while not indiscriminate, has swallowed select zones and regions whole, reducing them to heavily quarantined White-Zones. 
You're one of the later waves sent to the facility. What fate has befallen to the earlier waves is unknown. Don't become one of them.

Things to note:
7+ graphics are recommended.
Best played on a private server
The controls are laid out on the screen at the class lockers
The game is challenging and you are expected to falter in the beginning, don't give up!

Rules & Credits - https://devforum.roblox.com/t/examination-rules-credits/3809900

The MTR South Island Line is a rapid transit line of Hong Kong's MTR metro system. This line connects the Hong Kong business district from Admiralty station to the Southern District of Hong Kong Island. 

In this game you can either manually control the train or get on the train as a passenger. The rolling stock of the South Island line is purpose-built for driverless operation, which is highly recreated in the game.

- Detailed train stations 
- Advance auto train with signal system

5364600678.creator: - Nebula Games -
5364600678.description:
Serve waybills and hear the rolling thunder out on the high iron!

High Iron is a realistic North American train simulator that encourages you to play your own way! Choose from our unique selection of locomotives and rolling stock to assemble your own train and ride the rails! Cruise down the mainline, stop at stations, switch cars at industries, and more!

This game is in early development and is paid access as a result, but will be free-to-play down the line! You may experience bugs or find incomplete features during this stage of production. In its current form, High Iron is a free-roam sandbox game, but will later feature a currency system and objectives that can be completed to earn rewards and collect new trains! Developing such features takes time, and we do not have a consistent update schedule, so please be patient while waiting for new content.

To be informed about future updates, join the Nebula Games group!

Loaded shotgun. Mixed shells. Your move.

Take turns with a shotgun loaded with lives and blanks. Shoot your rival, or risk a blank to keep the turn. Count every shell that's spent, play the odds, and lie to their face.

🔫 Duels and brawls
Tense 1v1 duels or 4-player tables where nobody trusts anybody.

🎒 Items
Peek shells, rack one out, handcuff rivals, heal, invert a shell, or steal what they were saving. Every item flips the round.

🏆 Ranked
Climb from placements to the top of the ladder. Seasonal ranks, exclusive titles, and a global top 100.

🎨 Skins and titles
Win cash, open cases, unbox skins from Common to Contraband and beyond. Rare drops roll a TrakStat module that counts your kills. Collect animated titles, level up, clear daily quests.

💱 Trading
Trade skins and titles with anyone, or hit the Trading Hub to hunt for limiteds. Some guns only exist in the double digits.

👍 Like the game and join our group for a free Deluxe Case + cash.

5750914919.creator: Fisching
5750914919.description:
🦈 Welcome to Fisch 🦈

Dive into Fisch, the ultimate fishing adventure where exploration and progression are yours to control. Cast your line to catch rare and unique fish, each with 400,000+ possible variations. Explore a growing world with your trusty rod, and maybe even reel in some new friends along the way!

[How To Fish]
• Hold down to cast your bobber
• Await a bite. You can "shake" your rod to attract fish faster
• When you have a bite, hold down or click to pull the white bar. Follow the blue line to the best of your ability; it's okay to mess up a few times!
• When the progress bar on the bottom is full, you'll reel in your catch!
5750914919.name: Fisch 🦈

9229146348.description:
Welcome to JUST ONE MORE ASYM.

JOMA is an asymmetrical game with a juggernaut-style spin on it. One AI controlled killer and their player controlled cohorts hunting down 13 survivors.

You can either run and survive, or stand your ground and *eliminate what's hunting you in the first place in this 4v13 half-asym half-juggernaut.

ABERRANT | The AI controlled killer. Usually the main threat with high killing power. Use their behavior against them or work with the others to drive them back.
ADVERSARY | The chosen sub-killers that protect the main killer. Ranging from supports to attackers, use the aberrant to your advantage,
SURVIVORS | Survive till the end and fight back to the best of your ability. Run only if the situation calls for it.

Game mostly inspired by random Roblox asymmetrical horror games, though otherwise sticks to mostly original content.

[ GAME RULES ]
1. No Exploiting
2. No Intentional Bug Abuse
